newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway govt revises up GDP growth in 1996 and 1997.
newsitem.headline: Norway govt revises up GDP growth in 1996 and 1997.

text.p: The Norwegian government in its 1997 draft budget on Friday revised upwards its forcast for overall gross domestic product for 1996 and 1997.
The government said it expected GDP in 1996 to rise by 5.3 percent compared to a previous forecast of 4.5 percent in its revised 1996 budget in May.
The government saw 1997 GDP growth at 3.1 percent, compared with 2.3 percent in the previous forecast.
It forecast mainland GDP, which excludes the offshore oil and gas industry, to rise by 3.4 percent this year compared with expectations of 3.0 percent in May.
Mainland GDP in 1997 was seen growing at 2.5 percent versus 2.0 percent earlier.
